content.title: Short-term rental program rules
content.summary: The City of Arvada regulates short-term rentals (STRs), defined as residential properties rented for periods of 2-29 days, through an established STR Program aimed at ensuring the health, safety, and welfare of occupants while preserving neighborhood character. The program includes specific rules, application procedures, and complaint processes, with the authority to amend these rules as needed. Applicants must submit a permit application to the city, adhering to outlined standards and requirements.
